checkedAlternates.risk: Capital Gains Tax applies when selling real estate or shares.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Capital Gains Tax taxes realized investment income/profit upon sale (group-4), rather than recurring ownership of wealth/property (group-2).
Customs tariffs are levied on cross-border goods flows (group-3), not corporate net profits (group-4).
